kev_metadata.shortDescription: JQuery contains a persistent cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. When passing maliciously formed, untrusted input enclosed in HTML tags, JQuery's DOM manipulators can execute untrusted code in the context of the user's browser.

title: Cisco IOS XR Software Discovery Protocol Format String Vulnerability
